 Order

The present appeal has been preferred by the appellant seeking to assail the judgment dated 02.06.2018 and the order on sentence dated 08.06.2018 passed by the learned Trial Court vide which the appellant was sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of 12 years for the offence punishable undersection 376 IPC alongwith payment of fine of Rs. 5,000/-, thereof in default to undergo rigorous imprisonment for 1 month.

He was further directed to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of 07 years for the offence punishable under Section 452 IPC , along with payment of a fine of Rs. 5,000, in default of payment, he was directed to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of 1 month.

He was further sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of 2 years for the offence punishable under Section 506 IPC, with a fine of Rs. 2,000, in default thereof, to undergo rigorous imprisonment for 1 month.
He was sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of 10 years for the

The benefit of Section 428 Cr.P.C. was also to be given to the appellant.

4. Let a report be also requisitioned from the Secretary, Delhi State Legal Services Authority, Rouse Avenue Courts Complex, New Delhi on the aspect of disbursal of compensation and receipt thereof by the victim.

The IO is directed to facilitate the victim in approaching the victim to the Secretary,
DSLSA and ensure that the awarded amount be released to the victim within a period of one week from today.
MANOJ KUMAR OHRI, J AUGUST 8, 2025/rd
